subject.title: Workspaces: add scoped Teams control hub

question: Should OpenClaw change its documented one-trusted-operator Gateway model to support mutually untrusted local Teams members with per-resource isolation on one Gateway?
rationale: The patch is designed around a new adversarial user boundary, while current SECURITY.md explicitly rejects that boundary; tests cannot determine whether the product should make this security guarantee.

options.title: Keep the current trust model
options.body: Do not merge the local Teams identity and shared-Gateway isolation surfaces; use separate gateways or hosts for separate user trust boundaries.

options.title: Adopt the Teams boundary
options.body: Approve shared-Gateway multi-user isolation and require threat-model, compatibility, migration, adversarial proof, and permanent API ownership before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep the current trust model
recommendation.body: Do not merge the local Teams identity and shared-Gateway isolation surfaces; use separate gateways or hosts for separate user trust boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history ties this person to Gateway authorization, role policy, and plugin method contracts, which are the primary decision surfaces.
